title: The Cane left; the library returned
matchup: Turbo Stasis against blue control opponent
story: I had only three cards left in my library, and Howling Mine was making each draw step dangerous. My Feldon's Cane and Stasis had been on the battlefield since earlier turns. At the end of my opponent's turn, I tapped it and exiled it to activate the ability. When that ability resolved, I shuffled the cards in my graveyard back into my library. The Cane itself was not among them; it was already exiled as part of the cost. My opponent still controlled their own graveyard, untouched. I had bought more possible draw steps, not drawn an extra card or recovered the Cane.
review: Feldon's Cane tap+exile activation costs paid before resolving. Only controller graveyard shuffled into their library; Cane exiled does not return. Howling Mine adds draws. 1996 deck contains both.
